scope: 28 commissioned article illustrations and one cover for November only; older editions not changed
method: Read all supplied literary pieces; triage contact sheets then inspect every image at full resolution; inspect each selected replacement; compare cultural details with cited references. AI visual review, not specialist ethnographic certification.
style: Cartoon Natural: dark outlines, expressive simple faces, broad matte colours, restrained shadows, natural gestures; Odisha elements selected for each story, not added as a checklist.
publication: Existing authorized unlisted route only, no homepage/current issue/discovery entry
